name: Grimand's Finest Work
label: Quest
description: Grimand's Finest Work: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Grimand wipes sweat from his brow, beaming with a sense of pride.

There you are, my friend. This is some of my finest work - as good as the barding I personally made for Lord Shadowbreaker when he went for his own charger. I thank you for your trust in me to provide for you the best.
No doubt Grayson will want to see the work for himself as well. Take your barding to him, and give him my thanks for his honorable business.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're progressing along nicely, friend. Once you have made your barding, you'll be well on your way to the next task.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is most impressive work. It seems that as Grimand gets older, his craftsmanship continues to improve. That's quite the feat when his work was already some of the finest you'd find anywhere when he made my barding back in the day.

While this barding would be a fine addition to any normal steed, we are not dealing with such a mundane beast. You'll need this barding blessed by an appropriate source for it to be worthy of resting on an adventurer's charger. I'll hold onto it for you until then.
